event.firm_key: GOLDEN CROWN BAKERY INC DBA PANZANELLA BREAD COMPANY
event.recalling_firm: Golden Crown Bakery, Inc. dba Panzanella Bread Company

products.product_description: Caraway Multigrain PAN Bread 3 lbs. SLC; The 3lb designation is for dough weight, not net wt. No ingredient statement on label. No labeling agreement with consignees. Sliced breads are individually wrapped in in plastic and labeled only with a label that shows the product's name and company name. Unsliced, whole products are packed in a brown paper bag and are generally not labeled. The brown paper bags containing product may also be wrapped with a larger unlabeled plastic bag. More than one individually packaged unit can be placed in the larger plastic bag. Rolls are sold individually. Firm stated that product can be distinguished by size and shape from other products.
products.reason_for_recall: Golden Crown Bakery, Inc. dba Panzanella is recalling all of their bread products due to undeclared soy, undeclared wheat and lack of product labeling.

products.product_description: Label reads in part "***Panzanella Bread Company Italian Peasant Bread 24 oz. ***INGREDIENTS: Unbleached enriched wheat flour (Niacin, reduced iron, thiamine mononitrate, riboflavin, frolic acid, enzyme, ascorbic acid [dough conditioner]), Sea Salt (Salt, magnesium carbonate) Canola Oil, Olive Oil Yeast (Sorbitan monosterate, ascorbic acid)*** Please note there are spelling error contained in the ingredient statement (frolic), commas are missing between ingredients, and capital letters are sometimes used. A cooking spray containing soy was used to produce the recalled product and soy was not declared on the label.
products.reason_for_recall: Golden Crown Bakery, Inc. dba Panzanella is recalling all of their bread products due to undeclared soy, undeclared wheat and lack of product labeling.
